title: Stairs-O-Plenty
description: Crafts 8 stairs instead of 4 for the Biomes O Plenty Blocks
body:
Inspired by the [Vanilla Tweaks](https://vanillatweaks.net/) datapack of the same style.
This datapack simply allows you to craft eight stairs instead of the standard 4. This only works for the Biomes O' Plenty mod blocks.
